input_contract: Only public 8x252 history, 4x6 belief-relative defender states, proposed/reference 8x4x3 commands and supplied frozen GRU 8x3 trajectory. Branch sign is auxiliary supervision only, never an input.
normalization: Mean/std of original train histories only; std floor0.01. Development validation never enters gradients/normalizers.
loss: Group-balanced window mean paired-effect MSE under common valid masks plus matched binary branch auxiliary supervision and response energy penalty. Both models use identical labels, optimizer, batches, seeds and fixed epoch budget; graph pooling is the architecture difference.
selection: Final epoch only, no early stopping or sweeps. Report all three seeds per architecture; choose median development group-effect-error seed per architecture for later frozen scoring/holdout, ties by seed.
limitations: Structured interventional-response learning, not proven SCM identification or a closed-loop advantage. S4 remains separate from original Levels. Must test frozen-MPC decision value, original safety and exact disabled fallback before any online promotion.
